learning_outcomes.text: Gain a deeper understanding of the strategic planning, control, and monitoring of technology and process innovations.
Learn the tasks of technology management, technology and business foresight, as well as methods and tools of technology management.
Apply idea generation methods, especially creativity techniques, to concrete practical examples, use methods for evaluating innovations, and conceptually develop the necessary processes.
Learn methods for core competency analysis for systematic R&D, technology, and process management in a practical way.

Are able to accompany a product idea through technical development to a successful product (up to SOP), considering early on not only technical solution aspects but also the economic side, and learning corporate values. The connection between product and process innovation is particularly clarified.

syllabus_topics: Innovation culture and success factors for systematic innovation and technology management
Methods of idea generation (creativity techniques) and strategic innovation planning
Influence of digitalization on innovation processes
